games.name: Call of Duty (2003)
games.guide:
Call of Duty 1 loads mods from folders.

1. Set your game folder on the Games tab.
2. Install a mod (zip) - it's extracted into the game's Mods folder.
3. Launch the game, open Mods in the main menu and enable it.

Most CoD1 mods are .pk3 files placed in the 'Main' or mod subfolder.
games.note: Classic maps, skins and community files.

games.name: Call of Duty 2

loaders.name: CoD2x
loaders.desc: Community patch for CoD2 (fixes, extra features).

games.guide:
1. Set your CoD2 folder.
2. Install mods; they extract into the game folder as a mod subfolder (e.g. 'mymod').
3. Launch the game and use Mods in the menu, or start with +set fs_game mymod.
games.note: Maps, skins, game files and community tools.

games.name: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare

loaders.name: CoD4x
loaders.desc: Community client/server patch for CoD4 with mod support and fixes.

games.guide:
1. Set your CoD4 folder.
2. Install the CoD4x client from the Mod Loaders tab (website button) and follow its instructions.
3. Install mods into the 'mods' folder, then pick them from Mods in the game menu.
games.note: A large PC modding community with maps and assets.

games.name: Call of Duty: World at War
folders: Call of Duty World at War

loaders.name: Plutonium T4
loaders.desc: Plutonium client for World at War (requires owning the game). Downloads the official Plutonium updater; on first run point it at your game folder. An online account on plutonium.pw is needed to play.

games.guide:
1. Set your WaW folder.
2. Download the Plutonium updater from the Mod Loaders tab, run it, and point it at this folder.
3. Install mods; they go into the game's mods folder or Plutonium's storage folder per the mod's readme.
games.note: Custom Zombies maps, campaign mods and assets.

games.name: Modern Warfare 2 (2009)

loaders.name: AlterWare Launcher (IW4x)
loaders.desc: Official launcher for IW4x and other AlterWare clients. Requires owning the game.

games.guide:
1. Set your MW2 folder.
2. Download the AlterWare launcher from Mod Loaders - it's placed in your game folder.
3. Run it once; it installs/updates IW4x.
4. Put mods in the 'mods' folder and enable them in-game.

games.name: Modern Warfare 3 (2011)

loaders.name: Plutonium IW5
loaders.desc: Plutonium client for MW3. Downloads the official Plutonium updater; on first run point it at your game folder. An online account on plutonium.pw is needed to play.

games.guide:
1. Set your MW3 folder.
2. Install a loader (Plutonium or AlterWare).
3. Follow the loader's first-run setup, then drop mods into the mods folder.

games.name: Black Ops 3
folders: Call of Duty Black Ops III
games.guide:
BO3 has official Steam Workshop mod support.

1. Subscribe to mods on the Steam Workshop for Black Ops III.
2. Launch the game, open Mods and enable them.

For non-Workshop mods use 'Install from URL' with a zip; check each mod's readme for the target folder.
games.note: Free maps, modes and mods through Steam Workshop.
